contract.name: Priya
contract.goal: Build general strength, first time following a program
contract.notes: Has dumbbells and a bench at home, no barbell.

plan.week_summary: Introductory full-body home strength week focusing on fundamental movement patterns using dumbbells and bench. Includes 2 structured hard strength days, 1 light accessory strength session, and 1 easy mobility session, staying within the target 85 total minutes.

days.title: Full Body Dumbbell Strength A
days.purpose: Build baseline muscular strength and master foundational squat and press patterns
days.structure: 5 min dynamic warm-up; 3 sets x 8 Dumbbell Goblet Squats, 3 sets x 8 Dumbbell Flat Bench Presses, 3 sets x 10 Dumbbell Single-Arm Rows (2 min rest between sets)

days.title: Guided Mobility & Movement Prep
days.purpose: Improve joint range of motion and decrease muscle tightness
days.structure: 15 min routine: Cat-camels, thoracic spine rotations, doorway chest stretch, bodyweight hip openers

days.title: Full Body Dumbbell Strength B
days.purpose: Build baseline muscular strength and master posterior chain and overhead patterns
days.structure: 5 min dynamic warm-up; 3 sets x 8 Dumbbell Romanian Deadlifts, 3 sets x 8 Dumbbell Overhead Presses, 3 sets x 10 Dumbbell Reverse Lunges (2 min rest between sets)

days.title: Core & Posterior Chain Stability
days.purpose: Enhance trunk stability and motor control with low fatigue
days.structure: 5 min warm-up; 3 rounds of 10 Dumbbell Glute Bridges on Bench, 30 sec Plank hold, 12 Standing Dumbbell Russian Twists (60 sec rest between rounds); 3 min cool-down stretch
